title: Amtrak Board of Directors - Meeting minutes | April/May 2026

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Amtrak Board of Directors - Meeting minutes | April/May 2026
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

The meeting minutes for any scheduled meeting of the Amtrak Board of Directors held during the month of April 2026 or May 2026.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ben Heckscher

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

For all cameras in the city on October 14th 2026, please provide in csv format if possible:
- Manufacturer / brand
- Make / model
- Camera type(s), including whether it is a fixed, Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) or multidirectional camera
- Geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude).
- For fixed cameras, the direction the camera faces 
- Installation date

For each software platform or application that has access to camera feeds, please provide:
- Vendor, product name
- Description of AI features and their intended purposes. Whether each feature is currently enabled, disabled, available but unused, or used on a trial or pilot basis
- Whether processing occurs on the camera itself, on City-controlled servers or in the cloud
- Relevant contracts, purchase orders, invoices, technical specifications, product brochures, user manuals, and licensing agreements.

For cameras installed or upgraded after January 1st 2024, please provide:
- Manufacturer's manuals, technical specifications, product data sheets, and sales brochures
- Budget requests, budget approvals, capital expenditure authorizations, and other records documenting the approval or allocation of funds
- Relevant City Council meeting agendas, minutes, reports, and supporting documents
- Purchase orders, invoices, payment records

For all Point Tilt Zoom (PTZ) cameras provide:
- 2 minutes of footage from 4:00PM to 4:02PM on October 14th 2026 at native recorded resolution and frame rate.
- Camera identifier and location identified for each recording
- Access logs, activity logs and audit logs for 2025-Present
Where available, please provide logs in their original machine-readable format, together with documentation to interpret the fields.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Moreno Morales

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

All records responsive to the following deceased individual, including, but not limited to, arrest records, incident reports, or investigative files:

FBI NUMBER: 732773G
ROBERT ANDREW BERDELLA, JR. (born 1949, died 1992. See attached obituary)

Please see the attached Kansas City Police Department report, dated APRIL 6, 1988, for additional context regarding ROBERT ANDREW BERDELLA JR.’S criminal history.

I am requesting these records as an independent local historian and legal researcher. This information is not intended for commercial use.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.
